headline: US weighs forcing nations to pick its AI bloc or China's
body: A busy day with eight stories; the biggest was geopolitical. Reuters reported Washington may warn dozens of countries that joining Beijing's AI framework would shut them out of a US-led coalition. Splitting the world into rival blocs weakens Global Coordination, which lifts Self-Destruction and drags down Gatekeeper, the ending that needs nations working together. Reports that China is slowing critical-material exports to Taiwan added to Catastrophic Risk. On the brighter side, Claude-designed proteins hit 14 of 15 targets and Unitree's huge IPO pushed Capability Velocity, OpenAI piloted a privacy-preserving abuse monitor, and Pew found most Americans more worried than excited about AI. Horizon Balance held at -2.38; Benevolent Dictator moved above Conquerors.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.3, from the US bloc ultimatum (+0.17) and China's material curbs on Taiwan (+0.13), partly offset by OpenAI's abuse monitoring (-0.03). 1984 -0.2, from the US bloc ultimatum (-0.14) and Claude-designed protein binders (-0.03). Gatekeeper -0.2, from the US bloc ultimatum (-0.24) and fading earlier news (-0.04), partly offset by OpenAI's abuse monitoring (+0.05) and smaller items (+0.07).
